items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I met him, because see, basically they were going to school there.

ctx.x: No, this was an African boy, "I spit on your tomb." I met him, because see, basically they were going to school there. And they were in Vellon Colombe (PHONETIC), in that section. See, because each person had a section. See, there was the Colombe, I'm Pigalle. I'm a Pigalle man. And this other part, the Left Bank (inaudible). Then you had --
